get.description: Returns the value for key if present, otherwise default, without raising an error.

keys.description: Returns a view of all keys in the dictionary.

values.description: Returns a view of all values in the dictionary.

items.description: Returns a view of (key, value) pairs in the dictionary.

update.description: Adds key/value pairs from another dict or iterable, overwriting existing keys, in place.

pop.description: Removes key and returns its value; returns default (or raises KeyError) if key is missing.

popitem.description: Removes and returns the most recently inserted (key, value) pair.

setdefault.description: Returns the value for key if present; otherwise inserts key with default and returns it.

clear.description: Removes all items from the dictionary, in place.

copy.description: Returns a shallow copy of the dictionary as a new, separate object.

fromkeys.description: Creates a new dict with keys from iterable, all set to the same value.
